compose_transforms_on_image: create a Compose object to apply a list of image transforms in sequence to a PIL Image
oneof_random_transform: create a OneOf object to randomly select and apply one transform from a list to an image
compose_with_bounding_boxes: use Compose to apply multiple transforms to an image while updating bounding boxes in place
oneof_with_probability: create a OneOf composition with a custom probability p to control whether a transform is applied
basecomposition_custom_operator: subclass BaseComposition to build a custom composition operator for image augmentation pipelines
